items.title: Røper plan A, B og C før skjebnehelga
items.excerpt: Før den første store testen i vinter avslører Einar Hedegart kva planar han har for sesongen. Dei strekker seg frå draumen om verdscup til ein Airbnb på Beitostølen.

items.title: Hungary: Millions in hidden cash found in Orban graft probe
items.excerpt: Investigators discovered bundles of banknotes buried in forests and concealed in buildings. The money was seized during an investigation into a former minister accused of accepting millions in bribes.

items.title: US loses measles-elimination status after 26 years, WSJ reports
items.excerpt: The Pan American Health Organization has reportedly stripped the US of its measles-elimination status after 26 years, as the country battles its worst outbreaks in more than three decades.

items.title: Tuchel to remind England of anti-racism protocols before Spain game
items.excerpt: Manager Thomas Tuchel will remind England's players of Uefa's anti-racism protocols before Sunday's Nations League fixture against Spain in Madrid.

items.title: Microsoft says all services working again
items.excerpt: US tech giant Microsoft says it has fixed problems that led to a global outage of its services. The glitch severely disrupted online communications in businesses and governments for more than 24 hours.

items.title: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC
items.excerpt: The author of a major review on youth unemployment, due next week, acknowledges the change would mean some young people losing out on benefits.
